title: Global pattern of screen failure in Samsung flip phones: Consumer Commission orders replacement of defective handset
description: Citing a global pattern of screen failures in Samsung's foldable phones, the Kolkata District Consumer Commission recently held Samsung India guilty of deficiency in service for refusing warranty repair on a Galaxy Z Flip 3.In a judgment delivered on July 3, the Bench of President Kollol Chattopadhyay and Member Udayan Roy referred to such a pattern as documented in a US class action lawsuit.Hence, the Commission ordered Samsung to either replace the handset or refund ₹85,000, along with ₹25,000
